join.evidence: The export holds this man twice: as an undated stub who is Salvatore Mazza's father (@I22@, component 1), and as "Rosario Mazza b. 1850 of Piedimonte Etneo" married to a Leonarda with no surname, heading the 110-person component 2 (@I23@). FIVE independent records make them one man. (1) Nati 1873 atto 3: Salvatore Mazza born 5 Jan 1873 to ROSARIO MAZZA DI MARIANO, 28, and LEONARDA BONANNO. (2) Marriage proclamation 1898: Mazza Salvatore, 25, son of Rosario, 53, and Bonanno Leonarda. (3) Marriage proclamation 1902: Mazza GIOVANNI, 27, son of Rosario, 55, and Bonanno Leonarda. (4) Marriage proclamation 1910: Mazza IGNAZIO, 23, son of Rosario, 65, and Bonanno Leonarda, both parents present and consenting. (5) Nati 1877 atto 168: ORAZIO Mazza born to Rosario, 31, and Leonarda. The tree's @I23@ has exactly these sons - Orazio, Ignazio, Giovanni - by a wife called Leonarda. Rosario's ages give a birth about 1845; the tree says 1850.

children.name: Salvatore Mazza
children.note: Nati 1873, atto 3 — Rosario, 28; and the marriage proclamation of 1898, where Salvatore is 25 and Rosario 53.

children.name: Orazio Mazza
children.note: Nati 1877, atto 168 — Rosario, 31, of via Grotta Nicodemo. The tree dates him 1883.

children.name: Ignazio Mazza
children.note: Marriage proclamation 1910 — Ignazio, 23, son of Rosario, 65, and Bonanno Leonarda, BOTH PARENTS PRESENT AND CONSENTING. The tree dates him 1885 and has him dying in America.

children.name: Giovanni Mazza
children.note: Marriage proclamation 1902 — Giovanni, 27, son of Rosario, 55, and Bonanno Leonarda. Almost certainly the Mazza Giovanni of the 1875 index, act 64, and the Mazza Giovanni, 54, who declared Salvatore's death in 1929.

undocumented.name: Gaetano Mazza
undocumented.note: Nati 1880, atto 66 — Rosario, 32, of Via S. Basile. Not in the family tree at all.

undocumented.name: Santo Mazza
undocumented.note: Parish baptism: «Sancturi Mazza natus die 8 ex Rosario e Leonarda Bonanno jug.» Probably the Mazza Santo of the 1882 index, act 75. Not in the family tree.
